name: Status Panel
description: Bottom panel mirroring the Claude Code CLI status line: model, effort, permission mode, directory, branch, context usage and plan limits
author: Mark Kinkade

marketplace.tagline: The Claude Code status line as a bottom panel
marketplace.longDescription:
Mirrors the Claude Code CLI status line inside Nimbalyst. A chip strip in the bottom panel shows the focused session's model, reasoning effort, workspace permission mode, working directory, git branch with uncommitted-file count, context-window usage, and Claude plan limits — the 5-hour and 7-day bars plus model-scoped caps such as `7d Fable`. A gear chip picks which segments appear and in what order, and that choice follows you across workspaces.

**Claude Code first.** This version is built for Claude Code sessions and does not report quota for Copilot, Cursor or Codex. Model names are resolved from Claude Code model ids, and the plan-usage chips read your Anthropic plan directly — so beside a session from another provider they say as much: they relabel to `Claude 5h`, render in the muted accent rather than green/yellow/red, and name that session's provider in their tooltip. The number stays, because your Claude plan is yours either way; what goes is the implication that it describes the session on screen. The provider-neutral chips — effort, permission mode, directory and branch — work regardless.
highlights: Model, reasoning effort, permission mode, directory and branch for the focused session
Context-window bar with input and output token counts
Claude plan limits: the 5-hour and 7-day bars plus model-scoped caps such as 7d Fable, relabelled and muted beside a non-Claude session
Gear chip choosing which segments appear and in what order, remembered across workspaces
marketplace.changelog:
0.1.4: The panel now tells you when a newer release is out. Nimbalyst never updates a GitHub-installed extension on its own, so an Update chip appears at the end of the strip when this repo has published a newer version, offering to install it -- always behind a confirmation, never automatically, and with the manual paste-the-URL path beside it. It asks GitHub at most once every few hours, shows nothing at all when it cannot ask, and switches off entirely under Behavior in the gear popover. Also in this release: every segment with no data now says why instead of vanishing, a folder that is not a git repository says so rather than showing an empty branch chip, and both read legibly on the light theme.
0.1.3: Light and dark screenshots of the panel now ship in the README, in the extension listing and inside the package itself. No functional change. This is also the first published release to carry 0.1.1 and 0.1.2, which were only ever built locally.
0.1.2: Beside a session from another provider, the plan-limit chips now read `Claude 5h` in the muted accent instead of a full-saturation `5h`, with a tooltip naming that provider. The readings are unchanged — they were always about your Claude plan.
0.1.1: The published byline is now Mark Kinkade, matching the LICENSE; no functional change.
0.1.0: First release. Chip strip for the focused session with model, effort, permission mode, directory, branch, context usage and Claude plan limits, plus a configurable segment order. Claude Code sessions only.
